name: Rizon Standard Visa Platinum
summary: An entry-level non-custodial Visa card with no monthly fees, designed for users who want to spend stablecoins directly from their own wallet.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

faq.question: Does the Rizon Standard Visa Platinum charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is US$10.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Rizon Standard Visa Platinum?
faq.answer: It charges about 1.7% on non-base-currency spending.
